seo.title: Terminal Automation
seo.description: One screen to run a fuel terminal: loading, tanks, safety, SAP integration and reporting.

hero.title: Terminal Automation
hero.subtitle: Twelve bays. Forty tanks. Hundreds of trucks. All of it, on one screen.

ctas.label: Let's run your terminal from one screen

sections.title: Software that watches, decides and records, everywhere at once
sections.text: A fuel terminal stores and moves petroleum products around the clock. Terminal automation replaces manual gauging, paper dockets and radio calls with one system that monitors every tank, meter and valve in real time, and keeps the record automatically.

items.title: Safety
items.text: Fire and gas detection and emergency shutdown, wired into the same system that runs the loading.

items.title: Accuracy
items.text: Every litre metered, reconciled and posted. The quantity that loaded is the quantity that billed.

items.title: Uptime
items.text: Predictive diagnostics flag a failing pump or valve before it stops a bay.

items.title: Compliance
items.text: Every action, alarm and shipment logged automatically. The audit trail writes itself.

sections.title: One system, not several
sections.text: Gauges, PLCs, safety system, barrier gates, fire panels, pumps and the SAP link all sit on a redundant dual-LAN backbone. The safety PLC runs separately from process control and reports its own health on a live diagnostic screen. The home screen is a launchpad: every part of the terminal is one click away.

sections.title: From gate to gantry, the queue runs itself

items.title: Barrier Gates
items.text: Entry and exit gates tied to the shipment, not opened by hand.

items.title: Bay Overview
items.text: Every bay's status at a glance across the whole gantry.

items.title: Bay Activation
items.text: Arming a bay for a specific shipment before loading starts.

sections.title: Every tank, read continuously, never on a rounds sheet

items.title: Tanks Overview
items.text: Level, temperature and status for every tank on one screen.

items.title: MS & HSD Tanks
items.text: Motor spirit and high-speed diesel storage and movements, gauged continuously.

items.title: Pump Overview
items.text: Every transfer pump, its state and its duty.

sections.title: Safe state is one action away
sections.text: The ESD overview shows plant shutdown status, power outputs, barrier gates and the SCADA shutdown command as a single board.

items.title: Hydrocarbon Detectors
items.text: Gas detection across the terminal, mapped live.

items.title: Overspill Detectors
items.text: Catching an overfill before it becomes a spill.

items.title: Water Draw-Off & Dyke Valves
items.text: Controlled draining without breaking containment.

items.title: UPS & Diesel Generator
items.text: Backup power health and auto-start readiness, monitored continuously.

items.title: Alarms
items.text: Active, acknowledged and cleared alarms, colour-coded with time raised and who acknowledged.

items.title: Events & Operator Actions
items.text: Every system event and every operator action, logged in sequence.

items.title: Shipment Tracking
items.text: Each shipment followed from setup to completion as one tracked record.

sections.title: The terminal talks to SAP directly
sections.text: Shipments, loading confirmations and material movements pass between the terminal system and SAP automatically. Users, roles, products, vehicles, bay assignments and tolerances are configured once and applied everywhere.

sections.title: Auditable precision from batch loading to custody transfer

items.title: Metering Telemetry
items.text: ASTM D1250 temperature and density correction; meter proving audit.

items.title: Mass Balance

items.title: Regulatory Audit
